Stock prices come from Finnhub, a market data service. Finnhub requires every user to have their own API key; the app does not include a shared key. You can create one on the Finnhub website. Finnhub offers a free plan; its limits and which exchanges and history it includes are set by Finnhub and can change, so check their pricing page.

How the app uses it: about one request per symbol per minute while the Stocks screen is open and the US market is open, no requests in the background, and automatic pauses when Finnhub reports its rate limit. Each quote is labelled from the Finnhub timestamp, so delayed or closing prices are never shown as real-time.
What is sent: the key, the symbols on your watchlist and your search text. No financial data from the app.
Open finnhub.io to get a key
The key is encrypted with an Android Keystore key and stored only on this device. It is excluded from backups and never logged.

Finances is a personal finance app that keeps your financial records on your device. It has no user accounts, no analytics, no advertising and no crash-reporting SDK. The only network requests are for exchange rates and, if you enable it with your own API key, stock market data.

Transactions, accounts, categories, keyword rules, budgets, receipt totals, notification processing results, exchange rates, your stock watchlist and cached quotes, and your settings are stored in the app’s private storage. Your PIN is never stored; only a salted PBKDF2 verifier bound to an Android Keystore key is kept. The market data API key is encrypted with an Android Keystore key.
Automatic Android cloud backup and device-to-device transfer are disabled for this app. Uninstalling the app or clearing its storage deletes the data permanently.

If you enable it after reading the in-app disclosure, the app reads the title and text of notifications from supported banking and payment apps (Revolut, Google Wallet, OTP Bank, Wise, Erste Bank, MBH Bank) to recognize transactions on the device. Notifications from other apps are ignored. Promotional and security messages are rejected. Raw notification text is not stored; the recognized transaction and a short status record (app, time, outcome) are kept, the status records for 30 days. Notification contents are never sent anywhere. You can stop this in the app and revoke access in Android Settings.

The camera is used only when you start receipt scanning. Text recognition runs on the device with Google ML Kit. The app stores the merchant, date and amounts you confirm; it does not keep the photo or the recognized text.

To convert between currencies the app requests reference rates from the Frankfurter API (European Central Bank data) and, if that fails, from open.er-api.com. These requests contain only currency codes. Like any web request they reveal your IP address to the service. You can turn automatic fetching off in Settings.

The Stocks feature is optional and off until you add your own Finnhub API key. When used, the app sends the symbols on your watchlist and the text you type into stock search to Finnhub, together with your API key and your IP address. The Finnhub privacy policy applies to that data. Watchlist and quotes are stored locally and are never combined with your financial records.
The app does not sell or share your data. Apart from the requests described above, nothing leaves your device.

Settings > Data management > Delete all financial data removes your financial records while keeping the app lock and settings. Reset app completely removes everything, including the PIN, API key and watchlist.
